tasks.title: Conversation #22
tasks.transcript:
WOMAN: Hi, my name is Sarah Ferguson, and I made a reservation for a non-smoking room with a view of the river for two nights.
MAN: I'm terribly sorry, Ms. Ferguson, but our staff must have made a mistake, because according to the information in the computer, your room is facing the park, not the river.
WOMAN: That's terrible. I was hoping to have a nice view of the river from my room. Oh well, I guess mistakes happen. I'll just take the room facing the park then.
MAN: Thank you. And to make up for our mistake, we would like to offer you a free dinner coupon for two at our hotel restaurant located on the basement floor.

questions.analysis: 题干分析 问题询问他们在哪里，属于推理判断题，需根据对话中的地点关键词推断对话发生的场所。 选项分析 选项A：错误。 女士提到想要一间能看到河景的房间，但对话并未发生在河边，而是她在办理入住时与酒店工作人员交谈。 选项B：正确。 女士提到预订了房间（made a reservation for a non-smoking room），男士提到电脑中的房间信息以及酒店餐厅（hotel restaurant），这些关键词表明对话发生在酒店。 选项C：错误。 对话末尾男士提到酒店餐厅，但对话本身并非发生在餐厅，而是前台办理入住。 选项D：错误。 女士的房间是面对公园的，但对话并未发生在公园，属于地点混淆。

questions.stem: Why is the man apologizing to the woman?

options.A: He forgot to make a reservation.
options.B: One of his staff members made a mistake.
options.C: He does not know how to use the computer.
options.D: The restaurant is closed for business today.

questions.analysis: 题干分析 问题询问男士为什么向女士道歉，属于细节理解题，需抓住男士解释错误原因的具体说明。 选项分析 选项A：错误。 女士已经成功预订了房间，男士并未忘记预订，只是房间类型与预订不符。 选项B：正确。 男士明确说“our staff must have made a mistake, because according to the information in the computer, your room is facing the park, not the river”，说明是他的员工犯了错误。 选项C：错误。 男士能够从电脑中调取信息，并未表示自己不会使用电脑，属于无中生有。 选项D：错误。 对话中并未提到餐厅今天关门，男士道歉的原因是房间类型错误，而非餐厅问题。
